guidelines.detail: documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description explicitly includes gathering information and addressing concerns as work, while the reference activity has no counterpart in the generated model. The generated start event does not represent that work. FID-01 already says to model every distinct activity stated in the description.)

refines FID-01 (The generated start activity is labeled as receiving approval although the description says the process begins with an inquiry. The generated end label also states an outcome not specified as a terminal outcome, while the description identifies successful order placement and confirmation as the end. This refines FID-01 by making faithfulness explicit for element labels.)

documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description states how the process begins, and the reference includes a start event with no generated counterpart. FID-01 already requires modeling every distinct event stated in the description.)

refines EVT-03 (The description places customer approval after the quote and before order placement. The missing flows show divergence around the quote-to-decision and decision-to-order sequence. This refines EVT-03 by specifying how to model an approval wait in that sequence, without relying on the reference’s misplaced receive task.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant performs a distinct action

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes different actions or process states involving the same participant or subject at different stages: Label each BPMN activity and outcome to reflect the specific action or state described at that stage; do not substitute a different action or an unsupported outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes different actions or process states involving the same participant or subject at different stages

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a process may continue only after an external participant approves a proposal: Model the approval wait as an intermediate catch event after the proposal is provided and before the dependent activity; preserve that order rather than modeling the wait as a task.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a process may continue only after an external participant approves a proposal
